title: GPIO_SEL_2 undeclared after IDF upgrade
target: ESP32-S3 / ESP-IDF v5.0 (code written for v4.4)
compiler_output:
/project/main/main.c: In function 'app_main':
/project/main/main.c:7:25: error: 'GPIO_SEL_2' undeclared (first use in this function)
    7 |         .pin_bit_mask = GPIO_SEL_2,
      |                         ^~~~~~~~~~
/project/main/main.c:7:25: note: each undeclared identifier is reported only once for each function it appears in
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.document: ESP-IDF source: components/driver/include/driver/gpio.h (gpio_config_t), rendered in ESP-IDF Programming Guide GPIO API reference
reference_context.snippet: uint64_t pin_bit_mask;          /*!< GPIO pin: set with bit mask, each bit maps to a GPIO */

expected.root_cause: The GPIO_SEL_x macros existed in ESP-IDF v4.4 (hal/gpio_types.h) but are not in v5.0, so GPIO_SEL_2 is an undeclared identifier.
expected.fix: Use a 64-bit bit mask: .pin_bit_mask = (1ULL << GPIO_NUM_2) (or BIT64(GPIO_NUM_2)).
